description:
Feature umbrella for migrate-local-sql-rewrites-into-sqlglot-fork-20261120 and migrate-core-sql-text-rewrites-to-translator-20261122. Starts after sqlglot-adopt-30-35-0-2 merges, because both build on the adopted 30.35 wheel.

Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
- Scope is these two items only; cedardb-release-gate-cell-restoration and generalize-compat-lint-to-enforce-query-adapter-and-schema-e stay out.
- New named rewrites created for the ten core text rewrites go to the fork, not to _LOCAL_REWRITES.
- The '(c) list' of rewrites that depend on BenchBox-only state and cannot move must be shown to the owner and confirmed before any migration starts.
- Fork PRs are allowed under the fork's own rules; BenchBox adopts the resulting wheel through its adoption tooling.
- Delivery is serial: this umbrella is in each member's needs; one fork change set, one wheel, one BenchBox cutover PR.

Order: one combined inventory of the 22 _LOCAL_REWRITES entries and the ten UNRESOLVED_VIOLATIONS rewrites (move, delete as duplicate, or exception) recorded in context; owner confirms the exception list; fork PR(s) with the moved rewrites and tests; fork release delivered; one BenchBox PR adopting it and deleting the local copies and violations.
